description: The chart, labeled Figure 15: Token Ratio (TR), illustrates the token ratio across various categories, comparing the performance of three models: RedWhale, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). The horizontal axis lists six categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, while the vertical axis represents the token ratio, ranging from approximately 0.4 to 1.0. Each category is represented by a group of three bars, colored dark blue, blue, and light blue, corresponding to the three models, respectively. The bars for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) consistently reach the maximum value of 1.00 across all categories, while the bars for RedWhale and EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 vary in height, with values ranging from approximately 0.42 to 0.74. Notably, the bars for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 are consistently taller than those for RedWhale, with the exception of the KoBEST-SN category, where RedWhale's bar is slightly shorter than EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0's bar, at 0.69 and 0.73, respectively. The average token ratio is also depicted, with values of 0.57 for RedWhale, 0.61 for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and 1.00 for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). The bars are grouped by category, with no apparent sorting or visual emphasis.
